Answer: A
Reason: The 3D reconstruction (Figure 1) clearly visualizes an anomalous systemic artery arising from the descending aorta and supplying a mass in the lower lung zone, which is the pathognomonic vascular feature of intralobar pulmonary sequestration. While recurrent pneumonia is a common clinical presentation, the direct anatomical evidence provided by the imaging is the aberrant systemic arterial supply.
